probable_cause: Fear. Stopping the process.
affirmation: I trust the process of life. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I relax and let life flow through me with ease.

probable_cause: Not accepting the self. Disliking the self.
affirmation: I am beautiful and everybody loves me. I love and accept myself exactly as I am.
new_thought_pattern: I am a Divine expression of life. I love and accept myself completely where I am.

probable_cause: Running from the self. Fear. Not knowing how to love the self.
affirmation: I now discover how wonderful I am. I choose to love and enjoy myself.
new_thought_pattern: I love and approve of myself. It is safe for me to be alive. I choose freedom.

probable_cause: Social beliefs. Old thinking. Fear of being one's self. Rejection of the now.
affirmation: I love and accept myself at every age. Each moment in life is perfect.
new_thought_pattern: I bring love to every moment. I am timeless and ageless.

probable_cause: Feeling defenseless and hopeless. Nobody cares. A strong belief in not being good enough. Denial of the self. Sexual guilt.
affirmation: I am part of the Divine plan. I am loved and I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I love and appreciate all of myself. I am worthy of love.

probable_cause: Who are you allergic to? Denying your own power. Who or what irritates you?
affirmation: The world is safe and friendly. I am safe. I am at peace with life.
new_thought_pattern: I am one with all of life. I love and approve of myself. I release all resistance.

probable_cause: Not trusting the flow and the process of life. Distrust of the universe.
affirmation: I love and approve of myself and I trust the process of life. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I breathe freely and fully. I am safe. I trust the universe to support me.

probable_cause: Feeling unloved. Criticism. Resentment. Feeling victimized.
affirmation: I am love. I now choose to love and approve of myself. I see others with love.
new_thought_pattern: I am the joyous expression of life. All my interactions are filled with love.

probable_cause: Fear of money. Lack of financial support. Feeling unsupported.
affirmation: I trust the process of life. All I need is always taken care of. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I love and approve of myself. Life supports and loves me.

probable_cause: Guilt. Stuck in all that stuff back there. Get off my back!
affirmation: I release the past. I am free to move forward with love in my heart.
new_thought_pattern: I am free and I love myself. I choose to live in the now.

probable_cause: Lack of emotional support. Feeling unloved. Holding back love.
affirmation: I love and I am loved. I am open to giving and receiving love.
new_thought_pattern: I know that life loves and supports me. I open my heart to receive all the love in the universe.

probable_cause: Fear. Blocked creativity. Who or what is stopping you?
affirmation: My creativity flows freely. I am at peace with life.
new_thought_pattern: I freely express my creativity. Life flows through me with ease.

probable_cause: Fear of letting go. Holding on to old ideas.
affirmation: I freely and easily release the old and joyously welcome the new.
new_thought_pattern: I trust life. I release and let go of all that I no longer need.

probable_cause: Fear of taking in life fully. Not feeling worthy to take up space. Feeling suffocated.
affirmation: It is my birthright to live fully and freely. I love life. I love myself.
new_thought_pattern: I breathe life in fully. I am worthy of life.

probable_cause: Pushing too hard. Working too much. Not honoring yourself. Driven by fear.
affirmation: I relax into the flow of life and let life provide for me. I am enough.
new_thought_pattern: I take care of myself lovingly. I rest when needed. I am safe.

probable_cause: Deep hurt. Long-standing resentment. Deep secret or grief eating away at the self. Carrying hatreds.
affirmation: I lovingly forgive and release all of the past. I choose to fill my world with joy. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: I release all past hurts with love. I fill my heart with forgiveness and joy.

probable_cause: Anger and frustrations at life's seeming injustices.
affirmation: I now choose to create a life that is abundant. I am at ease.
new_thought_pattern: I now choose to release all criticism. I see beauty all around me.

probable_cause: Resistance. Boredom. Lack of love for what one does.
affirmation: Life is full of enthusiasm and energy. I am inspired and invigorated.
new_thought_pattern: I am enthusiastic about life. I love all that I do. I have abundant energy.

probable_cause: Too much going on at once. Mental confusion, disorder. Small hurts.
affirmation: I allow my mind to relax and be at peace. Clarity and harmony are within me.
new_thought_pattern: I rest peacefully, knowing life takes care of all my needs.

probable_cause: Refusing to release old ideas. Stuck in the past. Sometimes stinginess.
affirmation: As I release the past, the new and fresh and vital enter. I allow life to flow through me.
new_thought_pattern: I release the old freely and welcome the new with joy.

probable_cause: A desire to bark at the world. 'See me! Listen to me!'
affirmation: I am noticed and appreciated in the most positive ways. I am loved.
new_thought_pattern: I am heard and seen. I speak my truth with love and ease.

probable_cause: Anger you feel you do not have a right to have. Hopelessness.
affirmation: I now go beyond other people's fears and limitations. I create my life.
new_thought_pattern: I move beyond limitations. I express my feelings freely and joyously.

probable_cause: Longing for what might have been. A great need to control. Deep sorrow. No sweetness left.
affirmation: This moment is filled with joy. I now choose to experience the sweetness of today.
new_thought_pattern: My life is sweet. I choose to see life with sweetness and joy.

probable_cause: Fear. Rejection. Running off. A need to rush.
affirmation: My intake, assimilation and elimination are in perfect order. I am at peace with life.
new_thought_pattern: I digest life with ease. I am peaceful and secure.

probable_cause: Flighty, scattered thinking. A refusal to look.
affirmation: I am deeply centered and at peace with life. It is safe for me to be alive and joyous.
new_thought_pattern: I center myself in safety. I see life clearly.

probable_cause: Not wanting to hear. Too much turmoil. Parents arguing.
affirmation: I hear with love. I am a center of love and light. All is well.
new_thought_pattern: I hear the good. I hear the Divine. I listen with love and openness.

probable_cause: Breath-taking antagonism. Mental eruptions.
affirmation: Harmony and peace, love and joy surround me and indwell me. I am safe and secure.
new_thought_pattern: I am free and love myself. I am at peace with life.

probable_cause: Not liking what you see in your own life. Not wanting to see the past, present or future.
affirmation: I see with love and joy. I now create a life I love to look at.
new_thought_pattern: I see clearly. I love what I see in my life now.

probable_cause: Resistance, boredom. Lack of love for what one does.
affirmation: I am enthusiastic about life and filled with energy and enthusiasm.
new_thought_pattern: Life is full of joy and I express it freely.

probable_cause: Deep-seated tension. Fear. Resistance to change. Not good enough.
affirmation: I relax and allow life to flow through me freely. I release all tension.
new_thought_pattern: I am safe. I release all resistance. Life loves and supports me.

probable_cause: Unresolved sorrow. Loss not fully processed.
affirmation: I allow myself to feel and release my grief with compassion. I am healing.
new_thought_pattern: I am gentle with myself as I heal. Joy returns to my heart.

probable_cause: Invalidating the self. Self-criticism. Fear.
affirmation: I love and approve of myself. I see myself and what I do with eyes of love. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I release all tension. I relax into peace. I am loved.

probable_cause: Long-standing emotional problems. Lack of joy. Hardening of the heart. Belief in strain and stress.
affirmation: Joy, joy, joy! I lovingly allow joy to flow through my mind and body and experience. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: My heart is filled with joy. I open to love. Life flows through me with joy and ease.

probable_cause: Long-standing emotional problem not solved. Overloaded. Taking on too much.
affirmation: I joyously release the past. I am at peace.
new_thought_pattern: I release all burdens. Life is gentle and I flow with ease.

probable_cause: Fear of going forward in major decisions. Nothing to move forward to.
affirmation: I am in perfect balance. I move forward in life with ease and joy at every age.
new_thought_pattern: I dance through life with ease, knowing all is well.

probable_cause: Feeling threatened. Not trusting life. Attacking the self.
affirmation: My immune system is strong and healthy. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: My immune system is divinely protected. Life loves me.

probable_cause: Fear. Not trusting the process of life. Guilt.
affirmation: I lovingly release the day and slip into peaceful sleep, knowing tomorrow will take care of itself.
new_thought_pattern: I rest peacefully. I trust life completely. All is well.

probable_cause: Represents changes in direction in life and the ease of these movements. Criticism. Fear.
affirmation: I easily flow with change. My life is Divinely guided and I am always going in the best direction.
new_thought_pattern: I move through life with flexibility and ease.

probable_cause: Criticism, disappointment, failure. Shame. Reacting like a child.
affirmation: Divine right action is always taking place in my life. Only good comes from each experience. It is safe to grow up.
new_thought_pattern: I move forward with confidence. Life supports me.

probable_cause: Chronic complaining. Justifying fault-finding to deceive yourself. Feeling bad.
affirmation: I choose to live through the open space in my heart. I look for love and find it everywhere.
new_thought_pattern: Love and peace fill me to overflowing. I release all anger and resentment.

probable_cause: Depression, grief or fear of taking in life. Not feeling worthy of living life fully.
affirmation: I have the capacity to take in the fullness of life. I lovingly live life to the fullest.
new_thought_pattern: Life supports me fully. I breathe life in with gratitude and joy.

probable_cause: Sexual fears. Dislike being driven. Resistance to the flow of life. Fear.
affirmation: I relax into the flow of life and let life provide all that I need easily and comfortably. Life is for me.
new_thought_pattern: I relax and let go. I allow love to flow through my mind. All is well.

probable_cause: Refusing to see other sides of a question. Stubbornness. Inflexibility.
affirmation: It is with flexibility and ease that I see all sides of an issue. There are endless ways of doing things and seeing things. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I am flexible and open-minded. I see all sides with ease.

probable_cause: Fear, anxiety, struggle, rushing. Not trusting the process of life.
affirmation: I am on an endless journey through eternity and there is plenty of time. I communicate with my heart. All is well.
new_thought_pattern: I am peaceful and at ease. I trust life completely.

probable_cause: Fear. Need for protection. Running away from feelings. Insecurity. Self-rejection. Seeking fulfillment.
affirmation: I am at peace with my own feelings. I am safe where I am. I create my own security. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: I love and nurture myself in healthy ways. I am safe and secure.

probable_cause: Guilt. Guilt always seeks punishment.
affirmation: I lovingly release the past. They are free and I am free. All is well in my heart now.
new_thought_pattern: I release guilt and choose freedom. I forgive myself completely.

probable_cause: Deep fear. Terror. Feeling overwhelmed or out of control.
affirmation: I am safe and secure. I breathe easily. All is well. I trust the universe.
new_thought_pattern: I am centered and grounded. Life supports me completely.

probable_cause: Allowing confusion to reign. Giving power to outside influences. Rejection of the feminine processes.
affirmation: My bodily processes are a natural part of life. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: I honor my femininity and my cycles. I am at peace with my body.

probable_cause: Fear of being hurt. Deadening the senses of the self. Refusing to accept responsibility for your own feelings.
affirmation: I am alive to the joys of living. I deserve and accept the very best in life. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: I am open to tenderness. I love and accept my body fully.

probable_cause: Too much going on at once. Arguments and discord in the environment.
affirmation: I am peaceful and centered. I take one step at a time. All is well.
new_thought_pattern: I breathe freely and fully. I am at peace with my life.

probable_cause: Festering anger that is not released. Toxic emotions kept inside.
affirmation: I release the past with love and forgiveness. My heart is light and free.
new_thought_pattern: I choose forgiveness. I release all resentment. I am free.

probable_cause: Being hypocritical. Fear of money and of the future.
affirmation: I move into my greater good. My good is everywhere and I am safe and secure.
new_thought_pattern: I am safe and secure. Life supports me in perfect ways.

probable_cause: Carrying the weight of the world on your shoulders. Feeling burdened.
affirmation: I choose to allow all my experiences to be joyous and loving. I deserve ease and joy.
new_thought_pattern: I lay down my burdens and live in joy. Life supports me with ease.

probable_cause: The inability to speak up for oneself. Swallowed anger. Stifled creativity. Refusal to change.
affirmation: It's okay to make a noise. I express myself freely and joyously. I speak up for myself with ease. I express my creativity. I am willing to change.
new_thought_pattern: I speak my truth with love and confidence. I am heard.

probable_cause: Humiliation. 'I never get to do what I want to do. When is it my turn?'
affirmation: I move beyond old limitations and now allow myself to express freely and creatively.
new_thought_pattern: I deserve to do what I want to do. Life supports my authentic expression.

probable_cause: Fear. A strong belief that you are not good enough. What is eating away at you?
affirmation: I love and approve of myself. I am at peace with myself. I am wonderful.
new_thought_pattern: I am deeply loved by life itself. I digest life easily and joyfully.

probable_cause: Feeling pissed off. Usually at the opposite sex or lover. Blaming others.
affirmation: I release the pattern in me that created this. I am willing to change. I love and approve of myself.
new_thought_pattern: I release all resentment. I flow freely through life.

probable_cause: Fear. Feeling you must have protection. Fear of living in the world without enough support.
affirmation: I am divinely protected and guided at all times. I trust the universe to protect me completely.
new_thought_pattern: I nourish myself with love and wisdom. I am safe and protected.

probable_cause: Distrust of the universe. Not feeling safe. Fear of what might happen.
affirmation: I trust the process of life. Only right and joyous things come to me. I am safe.
new_thought_pattern: I relax and trust the flow of life. All is well.

probable_cause: Believing you are not worthy of love. Critical inner voice. Childhood patterns of inadequacy.
affirmation: I love and approve of myself. I deserve all good things. I am worthy of love.
new_thought_pattern: The love I give to myself overflows into the world. I am my own best friend.

probable_cause: Holding onto past hurts. Believing that unforgiveness protects you.
affirmation: I freely and easily forgive. Forgiveness is my gift to myself.
new_thought_pattern: As I forgive others, I set myself free. I choose peace.

probable_cause: Cutting off love. Feeling disconnected from oneself and others.
affirmation: I am at one with all of life. I am loved and supported everywhere I go.
new_thought_pattern: I am connected to all of life. Love surrounds me and fills me.

probable_cause: Suppressed emotions, injustice, need for control. Feeling powerless.
affirmation: I release all anger with love. I am at peace with myself and others.
new_thought_pattern: I channel my energy constructively. I choose peace over reaction.

probable_cause: Distrust of the universe. A need to control. Past experiences of trauma.
affirmation: I am safe. I trust life. I am protected and guided at all times.
new_thought_pattern: Love dissolves fear. I choose love in every moment.

probable_cause: Believing there is something fundamentally wrong with you. Toxic self-judgement.
affirmation: I am a divine creation. There is nothing wrong with me. I am perfect exactly as I am.
new_thought_pattern: I release all shame with gentleness. I am worthy of love exactly as I am.
